listing.original_game_title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Heritage for the Future
listing.summary: Upstream reports a native fight engine with 918 functions and character/stage replacements tested in Versus and Training. Other features, including Story and Arcade, use recompiled MIPS code. Portcove has not confirmed gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA PlayStation SLUS01060 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow INSTALL.md to build from source with your own SLUS01060 disc and the documented native macOS shell route. Full generation and capture tools live in a separate development repository; the main repository is not a complete setup by itself. Included extracted assets do not establish permission to use them.

warnings: Upstream reports a native fight engine with 918 functions and character/stage replacements tested in Versus and Training. Other features, including Story and Arcade, use recompiled MIPS code. Portcove has not confirmed gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
